```{r radarplot-all-tissues-DEGs-down-LFS-isogenic, fig.height = 16, fig.width = 16, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# for radar plot need to have tissues as cols and contrasts as rows b/c cols are the points on the circle and the contour is from the rows
df_radarplot <- as.data.frame(all_tissues_DEGs_down_LFS_isogenic_df_counts_matrix) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

rownames(df_radarplot) <- gsub(" \\(.*", # remove num genes in parentheses
                               "",
                               rownames(df_radarplot))

colnames(df_radarplot) <- gsub(" \\(.*", # remove num genes in parentheses
                               "",
                               colnames(df_radarplot))

df_radarplot <- df_radarplot %>% 
  rownames_to_column("temp") %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(temp, 
                     "K562|breast|osteo")) %>% # remove as not RNAseq or GEO2R and manual deseq # DEGs don't match and osteoblasts are all 0
  column_to_rownames("temp")

df_radarplot <- df_radarplot %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(`endo manual`,
                   `meso manual`,
                   `ecto manual`,
                   `core LFS tissues`,
                   `other LFS tissues`,
                ncol(.))) # removing all known targets col

# also need to have df row 1 = max and row 2 = min of each column
df_radarplot <- rbind(max = max(df_radarplot),
                      min = min(df_radarplot), 
                      df_radarplot)

# rearrange columns so that tissues with most p53 targets are together in plot
df_radarplot <- df_radarplot %>% 
  relocate(c(mesoderm,
             ectoderm,
             `adrenal gland`,
             brain,
             endoderm,
             lung,
             kidney,
             pancreas,
             liver,
             limbs),
           .after = 1)

# overlapping radar chart for all tissues

# Reduce plot margin using par()
op <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
          xpd = TRUE)

# Create the radar charts
pretty_radarchart(data = df_radarplot, 
                  caxislabels = seq(min(df_radarplot), 
                                    max(df_radarplot), 
                                    length.out = 5),
                    # c(seq.default(from = 0, 
                    #                           to = plyr::round_any(max(df_radarplot),
                    #                                           5, 
                    #                                           ceiling),
                    #                           by = 5)),
                  color = c("#c43d20",
                            "#a7a6ff",
                            "#ffa13c",
                            "#8c289a",
                            "#9eac13",
                            "#6d0011",
                            "#b2e37d",
                            "#ff5d68",
                            "#00a649",
                            "#779d59"))

# Add an horizontal legend
legend(x = "bottomleft",
  #x = "bottom",
       legend = rownames(df_radarplot[-c(1,2),]),
       #horiz = TRUE,
       bty = "n", 
       pch = 20 , 
       col = c("#c43d20",
               "#a7a6ff",
               "#ffa13c",
               "#8c289a",
               "#9eac13",
               "#6d0011",
               "#b2e37d",
               "#ff5d68",
               "#00a649",
               "#779d59"),
       text.col = "black", 
       cex = 1, 
       pt.cex = 1.5)

# trigger final plot
par(op)
```

```{r radarplot-facet-all-tissues-DEGs-down-LFS-isogenic, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 20, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
    )
```

```{r barplot-all-tissues-DEGs-down-LFS-isogenic, fig.height = 8.5, fig.width = 9.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
reformat_plot_df <- df_radarplot[-c(1,2),] %>% 
  rownames_to_column("dataset") %>% 
  reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(tissue = variable, 
                downreg = value)

barplot_all_tissues_DEGs_down_LFS_isogenic <- ggplot(reformat_plot_df, 
       aes(x = reorder(tissue, 
                       as.numeric(downreg),
                       FUN = median,
                       decreasing = TRUE),
           y = as.numeric(downreg), 
           fill = dataset)) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge(),
           stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = downreg), 
            position = position_dodge2(width = 1,
                                      padding = 0.2),
            color = "black",
            size = 4.5,
            fontface = "bold", 
            vjust = 0.5,
            hjust = -0.25,
            alpha = 0.5 # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
  ) +
  ggtitle("p53 tissue development targets downregulated in \np53-mutant cells compared to p53-WT cells") + 
  xlab("Tissue") +
  ylab("Known p53 developmental target genes downregulated in \np53-mutant cells compared to p53-WT cells") +
  labs(fill = "Dataset") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     position = "right") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0),
                   limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#56B4E9",
                               "#CC79A7")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, 
                      ((reformat_plot_df %>%
                             pull(downreg) %>%
                             max() %>%
                             plyr::round_any(5,
                                             f = ceiling)) * 1.000001))) + # call coord_cartesian for axis limits
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,0,10,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5))
barplot_all_tissues_DEGs_down_LFS_isogenic
```

# **Preparing Annotations and Matrix for Promoter States Heatmap** {#promoterstateshmprep}

$~$

```{r promoter-states-hm-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# make gene and tissue annotations i.e. column and row annotations for complexheatmap
promoter_states_hm_tissue_annot <- colnames(promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered)[-1] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Tissue = 1) %>% 
  transform(Germ_Layer = dplyr::case_when(Tissue %in% c("upperlimb",
                                                        "lowerlimb",
                                                        "kidney") ~ "Mesoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("lung",
                                                        "liver",
                                                        "pancreas") ~ "Endoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("brain") ~ "Ectoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("adrenal") ~ "Mesoderm/Ectoderm",
                                          TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
  transform(LFS = dplyr::case_when(Tissue %in% c("adrenal",
                                                 "brain",
                                                 "upperlimb",
                                                 "lowerlimb") ~ "Tissue where core LFS tumor arises",
                                   Tissue %in% c("lung",
                                                 "liver",
                                                 "kidney",
                                                 "pancreas") ~ "Tissue where other LFS tumor arises",
                                   TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>%
                                          transform(Tissue = ifelse(Tissue == "adrenal",
                                                                    "adrenal gland",
                                                                    as.character(Tissue))) %>% 
  transform(Tissue = gsub("limb",
                          " limb",
                          Tissue)) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Germ_Layer",
              "LFS"),
            as.factor) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Tissue")

promoter_states_hm_gene_annot <- promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered$Gene %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Genes = 1) %>% 
  left_join(.,
            cleaned_promoter_states_gerrard_2020 %>%
              dplyr::select(c(Gene,
                              CpG.1kb)),
            by = c("Genes" = "Gene")) %>%
  transform(Dataset = ifelse(Genes %in% reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes,
                             paste0("Gene in ",
                                    length(reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes),
                                    " p53 targets in development"),
                             "Gene not in p53 targets in development")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(CpG = CpG.1kb) %>%
  transform(CpG = dplyr::case_when(CpG == "TRUE" ~ "Start site within 1 kb of CpG island",
                                   CpG == "FALSE" ~ "Start site not within 1 kb of CpG island",
                                   CpG == "NA" ~ "Not referenced", 
                                   TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Dataset",
              "CpG"),
            as.factor) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Genes")

# define levels for CpG in certain order for heatmap
promoter_states_hm_gene_annot$CpG <- factor(promoter_states_hm_gene_annot$CpG,
                                            levels = as.vector(sort(unique(promoter_states_hm_gene_annot$CpG),
                                                                    decreasing = TRUE)))

# create named list for annotation colors on heatmap
promoter_states_hm_tissue_annot_namedcolors <- list(
  Germ_Layer = c(Ectoderm = "#7570B3",
                 Mesoderm = "#1B9E77",
                 Endoderm = "#D95F02",
                 `Mesoderm/Ectoderm` = "#488795"),
  LFS = c(`Tissue where core LFS tumor arises` = "#56B4E9",
          `Tissue where other LFS tumor arises` = "lightgray"))

promoter_states_hm_gene_annot_namedcolors <- list(
  Dataset = c(`Gene in 170 p53 targets in development` = "forestgreen",
              `Gene not in p53 targets in development` = "ivory2"),
  CpG = c(`Start site within 1 kb of CpG island` = "hotpink",
          `Start site not within 1 kb of CpG island` = "snow2",
          `Not referenced` = "gray20"))

# create heatmap annotation objects for rows and columns
column_ha_promoter_states_p53 <- ComplexHeatmap::columnAnnotation(df = promoter_states_hm_gene_annot,
                                                                 col = promoter_states_hm_gene_annot_namedcolors, 
                                                            annotation_label = c("CpG", "Dataset"), 
                                                            na_col = "white", 
                                                            show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                            annotation_name_side = c("left", "left"), 
                                                            annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                      fontface = "bold"))

row_ha_promoter_states_p53 <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(df = promoter_states_hm_tissue_annot,
                                                                 col = promoter_states_hm_tissue_annot_namedcolors, 
                                             annotation_label = c("Germ Layer", "Tissue in LFS"), 
                                             na_col = "white", 
                                             show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                             annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                       fontface = "bold"))  
  
# make matrix for complexheatmap
colnames(promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered) <- gsub("adrenal",
                                                           "adrenal gland",
                                                           colnames(promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered))

colnames(promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered) <- gsub("limb",
                                                           " limb",
                                                           colnames(promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered))

promoter_states_p53_matrix <- promoter_states_p53_prep_scored_filtered %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t() # for genes as columns and tissues as rows

# order matrix for heatmap based on annotations
promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered <- promoter_states_p53_matrix[rownames(promoter_states_hm_tissue_annot),rownames(promoter_states_hm_gene_annot)]



# same as above but in simpler matrix

# make gene and tissue annotations i.e. column and row annotations for complexheatmap
promoter_states_simple_hm_tissue_annot <- colnames(promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered)[-1] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Tissue = 1) %>%

                                                        "lowerlimb",
                                                        "kidney") ~ "Mesoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("lung",
                                                        "liver",
                                                        "pancreas") ~ "Endoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("brain") ~ "Ectoderm",
                                          Tissue %in% c("adrenal") ~ "Mesoderm/Ectoderm",
                                          TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
  transform(LFS = dplyr::case_when(Tissue %in% c("adrenal",
                                                 "brain",
                                                 "upperlimb",
                                                 "lowerlimb") ~ "Tissue where core LFS tumor arises",
                                   Tissue %in% c("lung",
                                                 "liver",
                                                 "kidney",
                                                 "pancreas") ~ "Tissue where other LFS tumor arises",
                                   TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>%
                                          transform(Tissue = ifelse(Tissue == "adrenal",
                                                                    "adrenal gland",
                                                                    as.character(Tissue))) %>% 
  transform(Tissue = gsub("limb",
                          " limb",
                          Tissue)) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Germ_Layer",
              "LFS"),
            as.factor) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Tissue")

promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot <- promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered$Gene %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Genes = 1) %>% 
  left_join(.,
            cleaned_promoter_states_gerrard_2020 %>%
              dplyr::select(c(Gene,
                              CpG.1kb)),
            by = c("Genes" = "Gene")) %>%
  transform(Dataset = ifelse(Genes %in% reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes,
                             paste0("Gene in ",
                                    length(reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes),
                                    " p53 targets in development"),
                             "Gene not in p53 targets in development")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(CpG = CpG.1kb) %>%
  transform(CpG = dplyr::case_when(CpG == "TRUE" ~ "Start site within 1 kb of CpG island",
                                   CpG == "FALSE" ~ "Start site not within 1 kb of CpG island",
                                   CpG == "NA" ~ "Not referenced", 
                                   TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Dataset",
              "CpG"),
            as.factor) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Genes")

# define levels for CpG in certain order for heatmap
promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot$CpG <- factor(promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot$CpG,
                                            levels = as.vector(sort(unique(promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot$CpG),
                                                                    decreasing = TRUE)))

# create named list for annotation colors on heatmap
promoter_states_simple_hm_tissue_annot_namedcolors <- list(
  Germ_Layer = c(Ectoderm = "#7570B3",
                 Mesoderm = "#1B9E77",
                 Endoderm = "#D95F02",
                 `Mesoderm/Ectoderm` = "#488795"),
  LFS = c(`Tissue where core LFS tumor arises` = "#56B4E9",
          `Tissue where other LFS tumor arises` = "lightgray"))

promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot_namedcolors <- list(
  Dataset = c(`Gene in 170 p53 targets in development` = "forestgreen",
              `Gene not in p53 targets in development` = "ivory2"),
  CpG = c(`Start site within 1 kb of CpG island` = "hotpink",
          `Start site not within 1 kb of CpG island` = "snow2",
          `Not referenced` = "gray20"))

# create heatmap annotation objects for rows and columns
column_ha_promoter_states_simple_p53 <- ComplexHeatmap::columnAnnotation(df = promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot,
                                                                 col = promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot_namedcolors, 
                                                            annotation_label = c("CpG", "Dataset"), 
                                                            na_col = "white", 
                                                            show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                            annotation_name_side = c("left", "left"), 
                                                            annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                      fontface = "bold"))

row_ha_promoter_states_simple_p53 <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(df = promoter_states_simple_hm_tissue_annot,
                                                                 col = promoter_states_simple_hm_tissue_annot_namedcolors, 
                                             annotation_label = c("Germ Layer", "Tissue in LFS"), 
                                             na_col = "white", 
                                             show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                             annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                       fontface = "bold"))  
  
# make matrix for complexheatmap
colnames(promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered) <- gsub("adrenal",
                                                                  "adrenal gland",
                                                                  colnames(promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered))

colnames(promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered) <- gsub("limb",
                                                                  " limb",
                                                                  colnames(promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered))

promoter_states_simple_p53_matrix <- promoter_states_simple_p53_prep_scored_filtered %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t() # for genes as columns and tissues as rows

# order matrix for heatmap based on annotations
promoter_states_simple_p53_matrix_ordered <- promoter_states_simple_p53_matrix[rownames(promoter_states_simple_hm_tissue_annot),rownames(promoter_states_simple_hm_gene_annot)]
```

# **Preparing Contingency Tables for Statistics** {#contingencyprep}

```{r contingencyprep}
contingency_tissue_known_reg <- data.frame(Tissue = names(overlap_comparison_list),
                                           Num_Known_p53_Targets = regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_num_vector,
                                           Remaining_Genes_in_Dataset = genes_per_dataset_num_vector - regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_num_vector,
                                           Total_Genes_in_Dataset = genes_per_dataset_num_vector,
                                           Percent_Known_in_Dataset = format(regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_num_vector/genes_per_dataset_num_vector * 100,
                                                                             digits = 2),
                                           Num_Putative_p53_Targets = regs_per_dataset_num_vector,
                                           Percent_Putative_in_Dataset = format(regs_per_dataset_num_vector/genes_per_dataset_num_vector * 100,
                                                                                digits = 3)) %>% 
  transform(Tissue = factor(Tissue,
                            levels = c("adrenal",
                                       "brain",
                                       "limbs",
                                       "lung",
                                       "liver",
                                       "pancreas",
                                       "kidney",
                                       "core_LFS_tissues",
                                       "other_LFS_tissues",
                                       "mesoderm",
                                       "ectoderm",
                                       "endoderm",
                                       "meso_manual",
                                       "ecto_manual",
                                       "endo_manual"))) %>% 
  arrange(Tissue)

# create df of median number of devel genes downreg per tissue after p53 mut in isogenic and LFS
contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher <- data.frame(`Developmental Dataset` = names(all_medians_DEGs_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher) %>% 
                                                                     gsub(pattern = "_DEGs.*", 
                                                                          replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                     gsub(pattern = "median_", 
                                                                          replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                     gsub(pattern = "regs_triple_overlap",
                                                                          replacement = "all known targets"),
                                                                   `Median Downregulated in Isogenic` = all_medians_DEGs_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher,
                                                                   `Median Downregulated in LFS` = all_medians_DEGs_down_LFS_WT,
                                                                   `Total Known Targets` = c(lapply(intersect(names(regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list), names(all_medians_DEGs_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher) %>% 
                                                                                                                gsub(pattern = "_DEGs.*", 
                                                                                                                     replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                gsub(pattern = "median_", 
                                                                                                                     replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                gsub(pattern = "regs_triple_overlap",
                                                                                                                     replacement = "all known targets")),
                                                                                                    FUN = function(x) regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list[[x]] %>%
                                                                                                      length) %>%
                                                                                               unlist() %>%
                                                                                               unname() %>%
                                                                                               as.numeric(),
                                                                                             length(reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes)),
                                                                   `Percent of Known Downreg in Isogenic` = format(all_medians_DEGs_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher/(c(lapply(intersect(names(regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list), names(all_medians_DEGs_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher) %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                                      gsub(pattern = "_DEGs.*", 
                                                                                                                                                                                           replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                                      gsub(pattern = "median_", 
                                                                                                                                                                                           replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                                      gsub(pattern = "regs_triple_overlap",
                                                                                                                                                                                           replacement = "all known targets")),
                                                                                                                                                                          FUN = function(x) regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list[[x]] %>%
                                                                                                                                                                            length) %>%
                                                                                                                                                                     unlist() %>%
                                                                                                                                                                     unname() %>%
                                                                                                                                                                     as.numeric(),
                                                                                                                                                                   length(reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes))) * 100,
                                                                                                                   digits = 2) %>% 
                                                                     as.numeric(),
                                                                   `Percent of Known Downreg in LFS` = format(all_medians_DEGs_down_LFS_WT/(c(lapply(intersect(names(regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list), names(all_medians_DEGs_down_LFS_WT) %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                 gsub(pattern = "_DEGs.*", 
                                                                                                                                                                      replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                 gsub(pattern = "median_", 
                                                                                                                                                                      replacement = "") %>% 
                                                                                                                                                                 gsub(pattern = "regs_triple_overlap",
                                                                                                                                                                      replacement = "all known targets")),
                                                                                                                                                     FUN = function(x) regs_triple_overlap_per_dataset_list[[x]] %>%
                                                                                                                                                       length) %>%
                                                                                                                                                unlist() %>%
                                                                                                                                                unname() %>%
                                                                                                                                                as.numeric(),
                                                                                                                                              length(reg_triple_overlap_targetgenes_db_genes))) * 100,
                                                                                                              digits = 2) %>% 
                                                                     as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                as.character)) %>%
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(.,
                              "\\.",
                              " ")) %>% 
  remove_rownames() 

contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher$`Developmental Dataset` <- factor(contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher$`Developmental Dataset`,
                                                                                       levels = c("all known targets",
```

```{r balloonplot-contingency-tissue-known-reg, fig.height = 10.5, fig.width = 6.25, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# to better show contingency table without numbers, make balloon plot of log2-transformed values, since the known genes are magnitudes smaller than the other genes for each row
df_balloon <- contingency_tissue_known_reg %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:3)) %>% 
  arrange(-Num_Known_p53_Targets) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = gsub("\\_", 
                       " ",
                       Tissue))
scale_lab <- expression(bold("log"["2"]*"(count)")) # allow subscript and make bold for legend

ggballoonplot(df_balloon %>%
                column_to_rownames("Tissue") %>% # log2 to reduce vast ranges between gene numbers
                log2() %>%
                dplyr::select_all(~ gsub("\\_",
                                         " ",
                                         .)),  
              fill = "value") + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("yellow",
                                  "blue",
                                  "red"), 
                       limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(log2(df_balloon$Num_Known_p53_Targets)),
                                                     0.01,
                                                     ceiling))) +
  ggtitle("Tissues/Germ Layers vs. \nKnown/Putative p53 Targets in Development") +
  xlab("Gene type") +
  ylab("Tissue type") +
  labs(fill = scale_lab) + 
  scale_size_continuous(name = scale_lab, 
                        range = c(1, 10)) + # circle size range of balloonplot function 
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme_bw() + 
  #theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 0,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(10,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,10,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    #face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.margin = margin(30),
        legend.justification = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        axis.line = element_line(color = 'black'),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0,"mm")))
```

```{r chisq-tissue-known-reg, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(head(contingency_tissue_known_reg[, 2:3], 7)))
```

```{r proptest-tissue-known-reg, warning = FALSE}
          alternative = "two.sided",
          correct = TRUE)

# here same as chisq value
```

# **Preparing Data for p53 Binding Sites Boxplot** {#bindingboxplotprep .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

As I plan to create a boxplot of the number of p53 binding sites across normal tissues and cancers in the ATACdb, I am preparing the data here for the plot.

$~$

```{r binding-boxplot-prep, results = 'hide', include = FALSE}
# merge footprints and sample metadata, remove redundant columns, subset to normal samples, and only keep tissues with enough sample number, and have overall number of samples to include in plot
ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal <- merge(cleaned_ATACdb_TF_footprint,
                                             cleaned_ATACdb_sample_metadata,
                                             by = "sample") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(sample_id.x,
                   sample_id.y)) %>% 
  subset(cancer_type == "Normal") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_tissues <- ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal %>% 
  dplyr::count(tissue_type) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  subset(n > 3) %>% 
  filter(tissue_type != "Other") %>% 
  pull(tissue_type)

ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_prep <- ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal %>% 
  subset(tissue_type %in% ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_tissues) %>% 
  transform(Type = paste0("Normal (n = ",
                          format(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal %>% 
                                   subset(tissue_type %in% ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_tissues) %>% 
                                   pull(sample) %>% n_distinct(), 
                                 big.mark = ",",
                                 trim = TRUE),
                          " samples)"))

# find p53 footprints in cancer samples of same tissues as normal samples and also put in boxplot (plot multiple boxplots on same tissues and color boxplots by normal or cancer), and only keep tissues with enough sample number, and have overall number of samples to include in plot
ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer <- merge(cleaned_ATACdb_TF_footprint,
                                             cleaned_ATACdb_sample_metadata,
                                             by = "sample") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(sample_id.x,
                   sample_id.y)) %>% # remove noncancer and normal samples
  subset(!(cancer_type %in% c("Normal",
                              "Other",
                              "Coronary artery disease",
                              "Branchio-Oculo-Facial Syndrome (BOFS)",
                              "CAID Syndrome",
                              "The Yellow fever",
                              "Asthma",
                              "Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV)",
                              "HIV-1",
                              "Hemoglobinopathies",
                              "Frontotemporal degeneration",
                              "Hypogammaglobulinemia",
                              "Systemic Lupus Erythematosus"))) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_tissues <- ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer %>% 
  dplyr::count(tissue_type) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  subset(n > 3) %>% 
  filter(tissue_type != "Other") %>% 
  pull(tissue_type)

ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_prep <- ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer %>% 
  subset(tissue_type %in% ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_tissues) %>% 
  transform(Type = paste0("Cancer (n = ",
                          format(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer %>% 
                                   subset(tissue_type %in% ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_tissues) %>% 
                                   pull(sample) %>% n_distinct(), 
                                 big.mark = ",",
                                 trim = TRUE),
                          " samples)"))

# rbind prep dfs (because same columns) so that can graph by normal or cancer in boxplot and make sample types and normal or cancer factors so that they are in specified order in boxplot 
identical(colnames(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_prep),
          colnames(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_prep)) # should be TRUE

ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot <- rbind(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_normal_prep,
                                             ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_cancer_prep)

# make normal appear before cancer in legend by putting it ahead in factor
ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$Type <- factor(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$Type,
                                                   levels = ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$Type %>%
                                                     unique() %>% 
                                                     sort(decreasing = TRUE))

# make sample type factors of everything except other alphabetical and add other at end
ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$biosample_type <- factor(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$biosample_type,
                                                             levels = c((ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$biosample_type %>% 
                                                                           unique() %>% 
                                                                           sort())[-which((ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$biosample_type %>% 
                                                                                             unique() %>% 
                                                                                             sort()) == "Other")],
                                                                        "Other"))
```

$~$

# **Performing GO, Hallmark, KEGG Over-Representation Analysis** {#clusterprofiler}

```{r clusterprofiler-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# pull out "leading edge" genes i.e. genes in our dataset which were hits in the GO development pathways
leading_edge_genes_embryo_enrich_list <- enrich_simplified %>%
  # filter(Description %in% enrich_categories) %>%
  mutate(geneRatio = DOSE::parse_ratio(GeneRatio)) %>%
  arrange(desc(geneRatio)) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  pull(geneID) %>%
  strsplit(.,
           "/")

names(leading_edge_genes_embryo_enrich_list) <- enrich_simplified %>%
  # filter(Description %in% enrich_categories) %>%
  mutate(geneRatio = DOSE::parse_ratio(GeneRatio)) %>%
  arrange(desc(geneRatio)) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  pull(Description)

leading_edge_genes_embryo_enrich_df <- data.frame(lapply(leading_edge_genes_embryo_enrich_list,
                                                         "length<-",
                                                         max(lengths(leading_edge_genes_embryo_enrich_list)))) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  replace(is.na(.),
          "") %>%
  rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
```

# **Manually Identifying LFS-Upregulated Genes in Senescence Databases and Upregulated in M2 Macrophages** {#senescenceM2macoverlap .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

```{r senescence-database-upLFS-overlap, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', include = FALSE}
# save genes upreg in LFS as variable to use to manually find overlaps with senescence database genes (setdiff(x,y) only keeps x that is not in y, so here nothing ever in downreg genes kept in upreg list)
upLFS <- setdiff(sort(unique(unname(unlist(mget(ls(pattern = "^DEGs_up_.*_LFS_.*_WT")))))),
                 sort(unique(unname(unlist(mget(ls(pattern = "^DEGs_down_.*_LFS_.*_WT")))))))

# since genes are repeated in cell age senescence database due to being mentioned in different studies, need to check that genes are consistently mentioned as inducing or inhibiting senescence, if genes induce in one study and inhibit in another or vice-versa, cannot include these genes
n_distinct(cleaned_cellage_website_avelar_2020$symbol) == cleaned_cellage_website_avelar_2020 %>%
  dplyr::select(c(symbol, 
                  `Senescence Effect`)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  nrow() # should be TRUE so df can just be subsetted to inducing senescence genes without more work

# combine genes from all senescence databases
senescence_db_genes <- c(cleaned_csgene_website_zhao_2016$symbol %>% 
                           trimws() %>% 
                           na.omit() %>% 
                           unique(),
                         cleaned_cellage_website_avelar_2020 %>% 
                           subset(`Senescence Effect` == "Induces") %>% # only genes inducing senescence
                           pull(symbol) %>% 
                           trimws() %>% 
                           na.omit() %>% 
                           unique(), 
                         cleaned_cellsignature_website_chat_2019 %>% 
                           subset(ovevrexp == 1) %>% # colname misspelled but only overexp in senescence
                           pull(symbol) %>% 
                           trimws() %>% 
                           na.omit() %>% 
                           unique()) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# identify overlapping genes of upreg LFS studies and in senescence databases
upLFS_senescence_genes <- intersect(upLFS,
                                    senescence_db_genes) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# clusterprofiler on upLFS_senescence to see if senescence pathways do show up
# convert genes to entrez id for clusterprofiler with seed just before lines
set.seed(1212)
bitr_upLFS_senescence <- bitr(upLFS_senescence_genes,

leading_edge_upLFS_senescence_genes_enrich_list <- enrich_upLFS_senescence_simplified %>%

  arrange(desc(geneRatio)) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  pull(geneID) %>%
  strsplit(.,
           "/")

names(leading_edge_upLFS_senescence_genes_enrich_list) <- enrich_upLFS_senescence_simplified %>%

  arrange(desc(geneRatio)) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  pull(Description)
```

```{r M2-macs-upLFS-overlap, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# combine genes down in M1 macs (i.e. up in M2) and genes from reviews important in M2 mac polarization
M2_macs_common_genes <- c(sort(unique(Reduce(intersect, 
                                             mget(ls(pattern = "^DEGs_down_M1_macs_.*"))))),
                          c('STAT6', 
                            'KLF4', 
                            'PPARG', 
                            'IRF4', 
                            'PPARD',
                            'MYC', 
                            'SOCS1', 
                            'KDM6B') # M2 markers from reviews
) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# identify overlapping genes of upreg LFS studies and in M2 macs genes
upLFS_M2_macs_genes <- intersect(upLFS,
                                    M2_macs_common_genes) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# no intersection between upLFS_senescence and upLFS_M2_macs
upLFS_senescence_M2_macs_intersect <- intersect(upLFS_senescence_genes,
                                                upLFS_M2_macs_genes) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()
```

```{r M1-macs-upLFS-overlap, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
                            'NFKB1', 
                            'RELA', 
                            'SOCS3',
                            'IRF5', 
                            'STAT1', 
                            'STAT5A', 
                            'IFNB1', 
                            'HIF1A', 
                            'JUN') # M1 markers from reviews
) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# identify overlapping genes of upreg LFS studies and in M1 macs genes
upLFS_M1_macs_genes <- intersect(upLFS,
                                    M1_macs_common_genes) %>% 
  trimws() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# clusterprofiler on upLFS_M1_macs to see if M1 mac pathways show up
# convert genes to entrez id for clusterprofiler with seed just before lines
set.seed(1212)
bitr_upLFS_M1_macs <- bitr(upLFS_M1_macs_genes,
                            fromType = "SYMBOL",
                            toType = "ENTREZID",
                            OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# run clusterprofiler with seed just before lines

enrich_upLFS_M1_macs <- enrichGO(gene = bitr_upLFS_M1_macs_entrez,
                                 OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                                 keyType = "ENTREZID",
                                 # universe = bitr_universe$ENTREZID,
                                 ont = "BP",
                                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                                 qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                                 readable = TRUE) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

                                    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                                    keyType = "ENTREZID")
```

```{r upLFS-senescence-grid, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 11.5, fig.width = 9, include = FALSE}
# identify which LFS datasets senescence, M1, and M2 macs genes came from # commented out is if i was just looking at the key leading genes in macrophage and myeloid differentiation but they are in the total list of genes anyways

GOI <- c(upLFS_senescence_genes
         # , upLFS_M2_macs_genes,
         # upLFS_M1_macs_genes
         ) %>% 
  trimws() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

LOI <- mget(ls(pattern = "^DEGs_up_.*_LFS_.*_WT"))

upLFS_senescence_GOI_df <- lapply(names(LOI), # not changing object name but M1 and M2 macs also here 
                                  FUN = function(x) GOI %in% LOI[[x]]) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rename_all(~ names(LOI)) %>%
  add_column(Gene = GOI) %>%
  relocate(Gene,
           .before = 1)

# plot as grid which LFS datasets the senescence, M1, and M2 genes came from
upLFS_senescence_GOI_gridprep <- condformat(upLFS_senescence_GOI_df %>% 
                                              dplyr::rename(`Upreg in LFS Astrocytes G245D` = DEGs_up_astros_LFS_G245D_WT,
                                                            `Upreg in LFS Breast Epi M133T` = DEGs_up_breastepi_LFS_M133T_WT,
                                                            `Upreg in LFS Osteoblasts A347D` = DEGs_up_osteoblasts_LFS_A347D_WT) %>% 
  mutate_all(funs(str_replace(., 
                              pattern = "FALSE", # remove FALSE from all cols for easier visualization
                              replacement = "")))) %>% 
  rule_text_color(`Upreg in LFS Astrocytes G245D`,
                  ifelse(`Upreg in LFS Astrocytes G245D` == "TRUE",
                         "red",
                         "")) %>%
    rule_text_bold(`Upreg in LFS Astrocytes G245D`,
                 expression = `Upreg in LFS Astrocytes G245D` == "TRUE") %>% 
  rule_text_color(`Upreg in LFS Breast Epi M133T`,
                  ifelse(`Upreg in LFS Breast Epi M133T` == "TRUE",
                         "red",
                         "")) %>%
  rule_text_bold(`Upreg in LFS Breast Epi M133T`,
                 expression = `Upreg in LFS Breast Epi M133T` == "TRUE") %>% 
  rule_text_color(`Upreg in LFS Osteoblasts A347D`,
                  ifelse(`Upreg in LFS Osteoblasts A347D` == "TRUE",
                         "red",
                         "")) %>%
  rule_text_bold(`Upreg in LFS Osteoblasts A347D`,
                 expression = `Upreg in LFS Osteoblasts A347D` == "TRUE") %>% 
  # rule_text_color(Gene,
  #                 ifelse(Gene %in% upLFS_senescence_genes,
  #                        "#D55E00",
  #                        "")) %>% 
  # rule_text_color(Gene,
  #                 ifelse(Gene %in% upLFS_M1_macs_genes,
  #                        "#0072B2",
  #                        "")) %>% 
  # rule_text_color(Gene,

  #                        "purple",
  #                        "")) %>% 
  # rule_text_color(Gene,
  #                 ifelse(Gene %in% upLFS_senescence_M1_macs_intersect,

  #                        "")) %>% 
  # rule_text_color(Gene,
  #                 ifelse(Gene %in% upLFS_senescence_M2_macs_intersect,
  #                        "black",
  #                        "")) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL,
             theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 10, 
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(2, 2), "mm"),
                                                fg_params = list(fontface = matrix(c("italic",
                                                                                     "plain",
                                                                                     "plain",
                                                                                     "plain"),
                                                                                   nrow = nrow(upLFS_senescence_GOI_df),
                                                                                   ncol = ncol(upLFS_senescence_GOI_df),
                                                                                   byrow = TRUE))))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)
```

```{r complexheatmap-genes-triple-overlap-datasets, fig.height = 3.65, fig.width = 29}
# need binary clustering in rows and columns because binary data and need jaccard distances, can only use single, complete, or average clustering for binary data
complexheatmap_genes_triple_overlap_datasets <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(datasets_genes_triple_overlap_heatmap_matrix[!grepl(pattern = "_LFS.*", rownames(datasets_genes_triple_overlap_heatmap_matrix)),], # to not plot core and other LFS tissues compilation in heatmap
                                                                        # pattern = "_201.*" to not  plot cistrome and census rows in heatmap
                                                                        col = colorRampPalette((c("white", "red")))(2),
                                                                        name = "Present",
                                                                        row_names_side = "left",
                                                                        column_names_side = "top",
                                                                        row_dend_side = "left",
                                                                        column_dend_side = "top",
                                                                        clustering_distance_columns = 'binary',
                                                                        clustering_distance_rows = 'binary',
                                                                        clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                                        clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                                        column_title = paste0("Known p53 Targets Implicated in Human Development (",
                                                                                              format(ncol(datasets_genes_triple_overlap_heatmap_matrix),
                                                                                                     big.mark = ",",
                                                                                                     trim = TRUE),
                                                                                              " identified)"),
                                                                        column_title_side = "top",
                                                                        column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                                        row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(datasets_genes_triple_overlap_heatmap_matrix)),
                                                                        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                               fontface = "italic"),
                                                                        column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(datasets_genes_triple_overlap_heatmap_matrix)))
draw(complexheatmap_genes_triple_overlap_datasets)
```

```{r complexheatmap-promoter-states, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 31.5}
# draw complexheatmap
# x <- scale(x) # scale and center columns
# x <- t(scale(t(x))) # scale and center rows

complexhm_promoter_states_p53 <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(t(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered))),
                                                   col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                0,
                                                                                plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)),
                                                                              c("blue", 
                                                                                "white",
                                                                                "red")),
                                                   name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                   na_col = "white",
                                                   row_names_side = "left",
                                                   column_names_side = "top",
                                                   row_dend_side = "left",
                                                   column_dend_side = "top",
                                                   clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                   clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                   clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                   clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                   column_title = paste0("Known p53 Target Genes With Differential Promoter States Across Human Embryological Tissues (",
                                                                         ncol(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered),
                                                                         " genes)"),
                                                   column_title_side = "top",
                                                   column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                   row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                        gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                          fontface = "italic"),
                                                   top_annotation = column_ha_promoter_states_p53,
                                                   left_annotation = row_ha_promoter_states_p53,
                                                   heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                       0,
                                                                                       plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(promoter_states_p53_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)))
) 

draw(complexhm_promoter_states_p53,
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
     annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
     legend_grouping = "original",
     merge_legend = TRUE)
```

```{r complexheatmap-upLFS-senescence, fig.height = 2.25, fig.width = 14, include = FALSE}
# although already made this in table format, converting to matrix for complexheatmap binary clustering
upLFS_senescence_GOI_matrix <- upLFS_senescence_GOI_df %>% 
                                              dplyr::rename(`LFS astrocytes G245D` = DEGs_up_astros_LFS_G245D_WT,
                                                            `LFS breast epi M133T` = DEGs_up_breastepi_LFS_M133T_WT,
                                                            `LFS osteoblasts A347D` = DEGs_up_osteoblasts_LFS_A347D_WT) %>%
  reshape2::melt(id = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Dataset = variable,
                Present = value) %>%
  transform(Present = as.integer(as.logical(Present))) %>%
  reshape2::acast(Dataset ~ Gene,
                  value.var = 'Present')

class(upLFS_senescence_GOI_matrix) <- "numeric"

# need binary clustering in rows and columns because binary data and need jaccard distances, can only use single, complete, or average clustering for binary data
complexheatmap_upLFS_senescence <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(upLFS_senescence_GOI_matrix, 
                                                                        col = colorRampPalette((c("white", "red")))(2),
                                                                        name = "Present",
                                                                        row_names_side = "left",
                                                                        column_names_side = "top",
                                                                        row_dend_side = "left",
                                                                        column_dend_side = "top",
                                                                        clustering_distance_columns = 'binary',
                                                                        clustering_distance_rows = 'binary',
                                                                        clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                                        clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                                        column_title = paste0("Genes Implicated in Senescence and Upregulated in LFS Cells (",
                                                                                              length(upLFS_senescence_genes),
                                                                                              " genes identified)"),
                                                                        column_title_side = "top",
                                                                        column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                                        row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(upLFS_senescence_GOI_matrix)),
                                                                        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                               fontface = "italic"),
                                                                        column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(upLFS_senescence_GOI_matrix)))
draw(complexheatmap_upLFS_senescence)
```

```{r enrich-dotplot-known, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 15, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
options(enrichplot.colours = c("red", "blue"))
enrich_dotplot <- dotplot(enrich_simplified,
                          x = "GeneRatio",
                          # showCategory = enrich_categories,
                          showCategory = enrich_simplified@result %>% 
                            mutate(geneRatio = DOSE::parse_ratio(GeneRatio)) %>%
                            arrange(-geneRatio) %>% 
                            pull(Description) %>% 
                            head(50),
                          title = paste0("Selected Pathways in GO ",
                                         enrich_simplified@ontology,
                                         " ORA for ",
                                         format(length(bitr_triple_convert_entrez),
                                                big.mark = ",",
                                                trim = TRUE),
                                         " Known p53 Targets Implicated in Human Development"),
                          label_format = Inf,
                          order = TRUE) +
  ylab("Pathway") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.005, 0.005),
                     limits = c(0,
                                plyr::round_any(max(as.data.frame(enrich_simplified %>%
                                                                    # filter(Description %in% enrich_categories) %>%
                                                                    mutate(geneRatio = DOSE::parse_ratio(GeneRatio))) %>%
                                                      pull(geneRatio)),
                                                f = ceiling,
                                                accuracy = 0.02)),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.015, 0.015)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm")),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black")) + 
    aes(shape = I(16)) + 
    aes(color = p.adjust) + 
    enrichplot::set_enrichplot_color(type = "color", name = "p.adjust")
enrich_dotplot
ggsave(file = paste0(fig_path,
                     "enrich-dotplot-known.svg"), 
       units = "in",
       dpi = 600,
       limitsize = FALSE, 
       width = 11, 
       height = 15)
```

```{r enrich-dotplot-upLFS-senescence-M1-macs-KEGG-module, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 3.75, fig.width = 10, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
                                plyr::round_any(max(as.data.frame(enrich_upLFS_senescence_M1_macs_KEGG_module %>%
                                                                    
                                                                    mutate(geneRatio = DOSE::parse_ratio(GeneRatio))) %>%
                                                      pull(geneRatio)),
                                                f = ceiling,
                                                accuracy = 0.05)),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm")),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black")) + 
    aes(shape = I(16)) + 
    aes(color = p.adjust) + 
    enrichplot::set_enrichplot_color(type = "color", name = "p.adjust")
enrich_dotplot_upLFS_senescence_M1_macs_KEGG_module
```

# **Drawing Venn Diagrams of Putative p53-Regulated Genes** {#venndiagrams}

$~$

To complement the clustered heatmap of putative p53-regulated developmental genes across datasets, I have created Venn diagrams to more specifically show how many putative p53-regulated developmental genes overlapped with known targets and temporally expressed datasets. More Venn Diagrams up to 7 overlaps can be made based on whichever datasets should be examined in more detail.

$~$

```{r venn-p53reg-census-cistrome, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
venn_p53reg_census_cistrome <- venn(list(`hp53-reg` = reg_targetgenes_db %>% 
                                           pull(symbol) %>% 
                                           trimws() %>% 
                                           na.omit() %>% 
                                           unique() %>% 
                                           sort(),
                                         `census 2017` = census_fischer_2017,
                                         `cistrome 2018` = cistrome_nguyen_2018),
                                    ilabels = "counts",
                                    ellipse = TRUE,
                                    ggplot = TRUE,
                                    box = FALSE,
                                    ilcs = 2,
                                    sncs = 1.5,
                                    zcolor = c("#E69F00", 
                                               "#009E73", 
                                               "lightgrey",
                                               "#CC79A7", 
                                               "#000000", 
                                               "#D55E00", 
                                               "#0072B2")) +
  ggtitle("Overlaps Between Putative p53-Regulated Genes in Human Embryo \nand Known p53 Targets") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16))
venn_p53reg_census_cistrome
```

$~$

```{r venn-intersects-grid, fig.height = 1.75, fig.width = 17}
# plot table of venn overlap genes as figure so that can put with venn diagrams
venn_intersects_gridprep <- tableGrob(venn_intersects_df %>%
                                        transform(Intersect = dplyr::case_when(Intersect == "adrenal brain limbs intersect" ~ "Adrenal gland, brain, and limb development intersection",
                                              Intersect == "core ecto intersect" ~ "Tissues of core LFS tumors and ectoderm development intersection",
                                              Intersect == "core meso ecto intersect" ~ "Tissues of core LFS tumors, mesoderm, and ectoderm development intersection",
                                              Intersect == "core meso intersect" ~ "Tissues of core LFS tumors and mesoderm development intersection",
                                              Intersect == "meso ecto intersect" ~ "Mesoderm and ectoderm development intersection",
                                              TRUE ~ Intersect)) %>% 
                                        column_to_rownames("Intersect"),
                                      cols = NULL,
                                      theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 10,
                                                             core = list(padding = unit(c(2, 2), "mm"),
                                                                         fg_params = list(fontface = "italic"
                                                                                          # ,hjust = 0, x = 0.1
                                                                                          # ,
                                                                         )),
                                                             rowhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "plain"),
                                                                            padding = unit(c(10, 2), "mm")),
                                      ))

venn_intersects_grid <- grid.arrange(venn_intersects_gridprep,
                                     top = textGrob("Known p53 Targets Implicated in Human Development of Multiple Organs and Tissues",
                                                    hjust = 0.4,
                                                    gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

```{r p53-binding-boxplot-normal-cancer, fig.width = 12.5, fig.height = 6, include = FALSE}
ATACdb_p53_binding_boxplot_normal_cancer <- ggplot(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot %>% 
                                                     transform(Type = gsub("\\(n.*",
                                                                           "",
                                                                           Type)),
                                                   aes(x = reorder(tissue_type,
                                                                   as.numeric(number_of_binding_sites), 
                                                                   FUN = median, 
                                                                   decreasing = TRUE),
                                                       y = as.numeric(number_of_binding_sites))) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(Type,
                                 levels = unique(Type))),
               outlier.shape = NA, # to avoid plotting outliers twice
               alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(Type,
                                 levels = unique(Type))),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                              jitter.height = 0,
                                              dodge.width = 0.75,
                                              seed = 1212), # to make jitter consistent
              alpha = 0.5) + # set transparency of points
  ggtitle("p53 Footprints in Tissues Present in ATACdb") +
  xlab("Tissue") +
  ylab("Number of binding sites") + 
  labs(fill = "Type",
       color = "Type") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(as.numeric(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$number_of_binding_sites)),
                                              f = ceiling,
                                              accuracy = 100))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015),
                     n.breaks = 7) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm"))) 
ATACdb_p53_binding_boxplot_normal_cancer
```

```{r p53-binding-boxplot-normal-stats, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8, include = FALSE}
# define comparisons to add stats via kruskal-wallis multiple groups nonparametric test
comparisons_kruskal_wallis <- list(c("Lung", "Brain"),
                                   c("Lung", "Kidney"),
                                   c("Lung", "Pancreas"),
                                   c("Brain", "Kidney"),
                                   c("Brain", "Pancreas"),
                                   c("Kidney", "Pancreas")
                                   )

ATACdb_p53_binding_boxplot_normal_stats <- ggplot(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot %>% 
                                                     transform(Type = gsub("\\(n.*",
                                                                           "",
                                                                           Type)) %>% 
                                                    subset(cancer_type == "Normal") %>% 
                                                    subset(tissue_type %in% c("Brain",
                                                                              "Kidney",
                                                                              "Lung",
                                                                              "Pancreas")),
                                                   aes(x = reorder(tissue_type,
                                                                   as.numeric(number_of_binding_sites), 
                                                                   FUN = median, 
                                                                   decreasing = TRUE),
                                                       y = as.numeric(number_of_binding_sites))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + # to avoid plotting outliers twice
  geom_jitter(aes(color = biosample_type),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              size = 2,
              alpha = 0.5) + # set transparency of points
  stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                     # label = "p.signif", # to just show stars for significance
                     # hide.ns = TRUE,
                     comparisons = comparisons_kruskal_wallis) + # Add pairwise comparisons p-value
  stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                     label.y = 1400) + # Add global p-value
  ggtitle("p53 Footprints in Normal Tissues Present in ATACdb") +
  xlab("Normal tissue") +
  ylab("Number of binding sites") + 
  labs(color = "Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 8) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm"))) 
ATACdb_p53_binding_boxplot_normal_stats
```

```{r p53-binding-boxplot-normal-cancer-facet, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 6.5, include = FALSE}
                                                                         FUN = median, 
                                                                         decreasing = TRUE),
                                                             y = as.numeric(number_of_binding_sites))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + # to avoid plotting outliers twice
  geom_jitter(aes(color = biosample_type),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.15,
                                         height = 0,
                                         seed = 1212), # to make jitter consistent
              alpha = 0.5) + # set transparency of points
  facet_grid(. ~ Type,
             scales = "free") +
  ggtitle("p53 Footprints in Tissues Present in ATACdb") +
  xlab("Tissue") +
  ylab("Number of binding sites") + 
  labs(color = 'Sample') +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(as.numeric(ATACdb_p53_binding_footprint_ggplot$number_of_binding_sites)),
                                              f = ceiling,
                                              accuracy = 100))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.035, 0.035)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015),
                     n.breaks = 7) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm")),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 11),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"))
```

```{r knowntargets-tissues-boxplot, fig.width = 5.75, fig.height = 8}
knowntargets_tissues_boxplot <- ggplot(contingency_tissue_known_reg %>%

              position = position_jitter(width = 0.02,
```

```{r knowntargets-tissues-down-K562-DMSO-WT-boettcher-boxplot, fig.width = 5.75, fig.height = 8}
knowntargets_tissues_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher_boxplot <- ggplot(
```
