```{r knowntargets-tissues-down-K562-DMSO-WT-boettcher-boxplot, fig.width = 5.75, fig.height = 8}
                                                                "mesoderm",
                                            "ectoderm",
                                            "endoderm",
                                            "meso_manual",
                                            "ecto_manual",

                                                           "brain",
                                                           "limbs"),
                            "Tissue where core LFS tumor arises",
                            "Tissue where other LFS tumor arises")),
  aes(x = Type,
      y = contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher %>%
        subset(!(`Developmental Dataset` %in% c("all known targets",
                                                "core_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "other_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "mesoderm",
                                                "ectoderm",
                                                "endoderm",
                                            "meso_manual",
                                            "ecto_manual",
                                            "endo_manual"))) %>%
        pull(`Percent of Known Downreg in Isogenic`) %>% 
        as.numeric())) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + # to avoid plotting outliers twice
  geom_jitter(aes(color = contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher %>%
                    subset(!(`Developmental Dataset` %in% c("all known targets",
                                                            "core_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "other_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "mesoderm",
                                                            "ectoderm",
                                                            "endoderm",
                                            "meso_manual",
                                            "ecto_manual",
                                            "endo_manual"))) %>%
                    pull(`Developmental Dataset`)),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.02,
                                         height = 0,
                                         seed = 1212), # to make jitter consistent
              size = 3) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Median Known p53 Targets in \nDevelopment Downregulated After \nMutant p53 vs WT in Isogenic Cells") +
  xlab("Tissue type") +
  ylab("Proportion of p53 targets in development") +
  labs(color = "Tissue") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(
    contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher %>%
      subset(!(`Developmental Dataset` %in% c("all known targets",
                                              "core_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "other_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "mesoderm",
                                              "ectoderm",
                                              "endoderm",
                                            "meso_manual",
                                            "ecto_manual",
                                            "endo_manual"))) %>%
      pull(`Percent of Known Downreg in Isogenic`) %>% 
      as.numeric()),
    f = ceiling,
    accuracy = 10))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015),
                     n.breaks = 5,
                     labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                                "#009E73",
                                "#0072B2",
                                "#D55E00",
                                "#999999",
                                "#F0E442",
                                "#000000")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm")),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,15, "mm"))
```

```{r knowntargets-tissues-down-K562-DMSO-WT-boettcher-barchart, fig.height = 6.75, fig.width = 9.5}
                       f = ceiling,

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                                "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
```

```{r knowntargets-tissues-down-LFS-WT-barchart-dots, fig.height = 6.5, fig.width = 9.5}
                       contingency_tissue_known_down_K562_DMSO_WT_boettcher %>% 
                         subset(!(`Developmental Dataset` %in% c("all known targets",
                                                                 "core_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "other_LFS_tissues",
                                                                "mesoderm",
                                                                 "ectoderm",
                                                                 "endoderm",
                           "meso_manual",
                           "ecto_manual",
                           "endo_manual"))) %>% 
                         pull(`Percent of Known Downreg in LFS`) %>% 
                         as.numeric() %>% 
                         max()),
                                              f = ceiling,
                                              accuracy = 2))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                                "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0,"mm")))
knowntargets_tissues_down_LFS_WT_barchart_dots
```
